name: Dance (Travel Subdomain)
body:
Associated Domain: Travel

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the dimensional hop power of the Travel domain.

Graceful Dancer (Su)

At 8th level, while you are moving at least at your base land speed, you gain a sacred bonus on all Acrobatics skill checks in that round equal to your Charisma modifier. You can use this ability for a number of rounds per day equal to your cleric level.

Replacement Domain Spells: 2nd—cat’s grace, 6th—dance of a thousand cuts, 8th—irresistible dance.
